verdict.rationale: LlamaParse exposes an official MCP endpoint that lets any MCP-compatible (natural-language-driven) agent invoke Parse/Classify/Extract/Split/Index as tools, and Classify explicitly supports natural-language categorization rules, showing real NL-command support for parts of the workflow. However, core parsing/extraction is primarily configured via SDK parameters, schemas, and CLI/API calls rather than a native chat-style NL interface for the whole product. Missing for 10: a first-party conversational/NL interface for core parse operations (not just via MCP glue), and independent evidence of using NL commands successfully in practice.
